description: Repair tuple insertion and prune block-0 pre-attention LayerNorm biases
proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 24 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0059 at 2,118 parameters/99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0115, an implementation error with no score because the helper omitted a tuple separator. This is the permitted exact repair: candidate, checkpoint, coordinate-3 zero constraint, ranking, and evaluation conditions are unchanged; only insertion syntax now emits a valid tuple. The helper orders remaining block-0 pre-attention biases by current absolute magnitude, fixes one per micro-trial, and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop at the first scored discard or error, no eligible coordinate, 14 micro-trials, or 20 wall-clock minutes. Repairing the unscored least-magnitude coordinate is more informative than moving to the next coordinate or another site because it isolates infrastructure from the original hypothesis.
summary: The repaired block-0 pre-attention bias policy evaluated its least-magnitude remaining coordinate, index 3 at -0.0104501. The 1,671-parameter candidate scored 97.30%, so it was discarded and rolled back. Outcomes: 0 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors after repair; frontier stayed 1,672 parameters/99.01%. Compute used one checkpoint migration and one official verification in about 1m23s. Stop reason: the first scored discard closed this site before the 14-trial/20-minute cap.
